flows.name: ai-simple-chat
flows.description: HTTP endpoint that sends user prompt to LLM and returns response
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: ai-simple-chat
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/ai/chat"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setHeader:
            name: CamelLangChain4jChatMaxTokens
            constant: "2048"
        - setHeader:
            name: CamelLangChain4jChatTemperature
            constant: "0.7"
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:openai-chat"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#openaiModel"
        - marshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - log:
            message: "AI response generated: ${body}"

flows.name: ai-chain-of-thought
flows.description: Chain-of-thought reasoning with multi-step LLM prompting
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: ai-chain-of-thought
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/ai/reason"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: originalQuestion
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "Break down this problem into steps. Problem: ${body}\nProvide numbered steps."
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:reasoning-model"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#openaiModel"
        - setProperty:
            name: reasoningSteps
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "Given these reasoning steps:\n${exchangeProperty.reasoningSteps}\n\nNow answer the original question: ${exchangeProperty.originalQuestion}\nProvide a final concise answer."
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:reasoning-model"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#openaiModel"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"question":"${exchangeProperty.originalQuestion}","reasoning":"${exchangeProperty.reasoningSteps}","answer":"${body}"}'
        - log:
            message: "Chain-of-thought completed for: ${exchangeProperty.originalQuestion}"

flows.name: ai-rag-pipeline
flows.description: RAG pipeline: embed query, retrieve context from vector DB, augment prompt, generate
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: ai-rag-pipeline
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/ai/rag"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: userQuery
            simple: "${body}"
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-embeddings:embed-query"
            parameters:
              embeddingModel: "#embeddingModel"
        - setProperty:
            name: queryEmbedding
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"vector":${exchangeProperty.queryEmbedding},"limit":5}'
        - to:
            uri: "qdrant:knowledge-base"
            parameters:
              host: qdrant-server
              port: 6334
              action: search
        - setProperty:
            name: context
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "Context from knowledge base:\n${exchangeProperty.context}\n\nUsing ONLY the context above, answer this question:\n${exchangeProperty.userQuery}\n\nIf the context doesn't contain enough information, say so."
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:rag-model"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#openaiModel"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"query":"${exchangeProperty.userQuery}","answer":"${body}","sources_used":true}'
        - marshal:
            json:
              library: jackson

flows.name: ai-sentiment-router
flows.description: Classify message sentiment with AI and route to appropriate handler
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: ai-sentiment-router
    from:
      uri: "kafka:customer-feedback"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: sentiment-processor
        autoOffsetReset: earliest
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: originalMessage
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "Classify the sentiment of this customer feedback as exactly one of: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, NEUTRAL, URGENT.\nFeedback: ${body}\nRespond with only the classification word."
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:classifier"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#openaiModel"
        - setProperty:
            name: sentiment
            simple: "${body.trim()}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "${exchangeProperty.originalMessage}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.sentiment} == 'URGENT'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:handle-urgent"
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.sentiment} == 'NEGATIVE'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:handle-negative"
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.sentiment} == 'POSITIVE'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:handle-positive"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - to:
                    uri: "direct:handle-neutral"
- route:
    id: handle-urgent
    from:
      uri: "direct:handle-urgent"
      steps:
        - setHeader:
            name: priority
            constant: "1"
        - to:
            uri: "kafka:urgent-feedback"
        - log:
            message: "URGENT feedback routed for immediate attention"
- route:
    id: handle-negative
    from:
      uri: "direct:handle-negative"
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "kafka:negative-feedback"
        - log:
            message: "Negative feedback queued for review"

flows.name: ai-error-classifier
flows.description: AI classifies application errors into categories for automated triage
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: ai-error-classifier
    from:
      uri: "kafka:application-errors"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: error-classifier
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: errorPayload
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "Classify this application error into one of these categories: INFRASTRUCTURE, DATABASE, NETWORK, AUTHENTICATION, BUSINESS_LOGIC, EXTERNAL_SERVICE, UNKNOWN.\nAlso provide severity (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL) and a one-line root cause suggestion.\nError: ${body}\nRespond in JSON format: {"category":"...","severity":"...","rootCause":"..."}"
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:error-model"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#openaiModel"
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: classification
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"error":"${exchangeProperty.errorPayload}","classification":${exchangeProperty.classification},"timestamp":"${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}"}'
        - to:
            uri: "elasticsearch-rest-client:classified-errors"
            parameters:
              hostAddresses: "elasticsearch:9200"
              operation: INDEX
              indexName: classified-errors
        - log:
            message: "Error classified: ${exchangeProperty.classification}"

flows.name: ai-multi-model-compare
flows.description: Send prompt to multiple AI models and aggregate/compare responses
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: ai-multi-model-compare
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/ai/compare"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: prompt
            simple: "${body}"
        - multicast:
            aggregationStrategy: "#multiModelAggregator"
            parallelProcessing: true
            timeout: 30000
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:call-model-a"
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:call-model-b"
        - marshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
- route:
    id: call-model-a
    from:
      uri: "direct:call-model-a"
      steps:
        - setBody:
            simple: "${exchangeProperty.prompt}"
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:model-gpt4"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#gpt4Model"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"model":"gpt-4","response":"${body}"}'
- route:
    id: call-model-b
    from:
      uri: "direct:call-model-b"
      steps:
        - setBody:
            simple: "${exchangeProperty.prompt}"
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:model-claude"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#claudeModel"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"model":"claude-3","response":"${body}"}'

flows.name: ai-document-summarizer
flows.description: Extract text from documents, summarize with AI, publish summaries
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: ai-document-summarizer
    from:
      uri: "file:/opt/documents/inbox"
      parameters:
        noop: true
        include: ".*\\.(pdf|docx|txt)"
        delay: 5000
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "tika:parse"
            parameters:
              tikaParseOutputFormat: text
        - setProperty:
            name: documentText
            simple: "${body}"
        - setProperty:
            name: fileName
            simple: "${header.CamelFileName}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "Summarize the following document in 3-5 bullet points. Focus on key findings, decisions, and action items.\n\nDocument:\n${body}"
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:summarizer"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#openaiModel"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"file":"${exchangeProperty.fileName}","summary":"${body}","processed_at":"${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}"}'
        - to:
            uri: "kafka:document-summaries"
            parameters:
              brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        - log:
            message: "Document summarized: ${exchangeProperty.fileName}"

flows.name: ai-intent-dispatcher
flows.description: Detect user intent with AI and dispatch to appropriate service handler
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: ai-intent-dispatcher
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/ai/dispatch"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: userInput
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "Classify the user intent into exactly one of: ORDER_STATUS, REFUND_REQUEST, PRODUCT_INQUIRY, COMPLAINT, GENERAL_QUESTION.\nUser message: ${body}\nRespond with only the intent label."
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:intent-model"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#openaiModel"
        - setProperty:
            name: intent
            simple: "${body.trim()}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "${exchangeProperty.userInput}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.intent} == 'ORDER_STATUS'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:order-status-handler"
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.intent} == 'REFUND_REQUEST'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:refund-handler"
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.intent} == 'COMPLAINT'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:complaint-escalation"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - to:
                    uri: "direct:general-ai-response"

flows.name: ai-conversation-memory
flows.description: AI chat with conversation memory stored in Redis for context continuity
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: ai-conversation-memory
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/ai/conversation"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: sessionId
            simple: "${body[sessionId]}"
        - setProperty:
            name: userMessage
            simple: "${body[message]}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "${exchangeProperty.sessionId}"
        - to:
            uri: "spring-redis:conversation-store"
            parameters:
              command: GET
              host: redis-server
              port: 6379
        - setProperty:
            name: history
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "Previous conversation:\n${exchangeProperty.history}\n\nUser: ${exchangeProperty.userMessage}\n\nRespond helpfully and concisely."
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:conversational"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#openaiModel"
        - setProperty:
            name: aiResponse
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "${exchangeProperty.history}\nUser: ${exchangeProperty.userMessage}\nAssistant: ${exchangeProperty.aiResponse}"
        - setHeader:
            name: CamelRedis.Key
            simple: "${exchangeProperty.sessionId}"
        - to:
            uri: "spring-redis:conversation-store"
            parameters:
              command: SET
              host: redis-server
              port: 6379
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"response":"${exchangeProperty.aiResponse}","sessionId":"${exchangeProperty.sessionId}"}'

flows.name: ai-anomaly-detector
flows.description: Use AI to detect anomalies in metrics and alert via Slack
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: ai-anomaly-detector
    from:
      uri: "kafka:system-metrics"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: anomaly-detector
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: metricsData
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "Analyze these system metrics for anomalies. Consider: unusual spikes, values outside normal ranges, sudden drops, correlation anomalies.\nMetrics: ${body}\nRespond in JSON: {"anomalyDetected":true/false,"severity":"LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL","description":"","affectedMetrics":[""],"recommendation":""}"
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:anomaly-model"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#openaiModel"
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${body[anomalyDetected]} == true && ${body[severity]} in 'HIGH,CRITICAL'"
                steps:
                  - setBody:
                      simple: ":rotating_light: *Anomaly Detected*\nSeverity: ${body[severity]}\nDescription: ${body[description]}\nAffected: ${body[affectedMetrics]}\nRecommendation: ${body[recommendation]}"
                  - to:
                      uri: "slack:#ops-alerts"
                      parameters:
                        webhookUrl: "{{slack.webhook.url}}"
        - log:
            message: "Metrics analyzed for anomalies"

flows.name: ai-content-moderator
flows.description: AI-powered content moderation for user-generated content
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: ai-content-moderator
    from:
      uri: "kafka:user-content"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: content-moderator
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: content
            simple: "${body}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "Moderate this user-generated content. Check for: hate speech, harassment, spam, misinformation, explicit content, self-harm references.\nContent: ${body}\nRespond in JSON: {"approved":true/false,"flags":[],"confidence":0.0-1.0,"explanation":""}"
        - to:
            uri: "langchain4j-chat:moderator"
            parameters:
              chatModel: "#openaiModel"
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - choice:
            when:

                    uri: "direct:flag-for-review"

                    message: "Content flagged: ${body[flags]}"

flows.name: saga-order-payment
flows.description: Distributed order+payment transaction with compensation on failure
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: saga-order-payment
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/orders"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - saga:
            propagation: REQUIRED
            completionMode: MANUAL
            timeout: 60s
            compensation:
              uri: "direct:cancel-order"
            completion:
              uri: "direct:complete-order"
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:reserve-inventory"
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:process-payment"
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:confirm-order"
              - to:
                  uri: "saga:complete"
- route:
    id: reserve-inventory
    from:
      uri: "direct:reserve-inventory"
      steps:
        - setHeader:
            name: Content-Type
            constant: "application/json"
        - to:
            uri: "http:inventory-service:8080/api/reserve"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - log:
            message: "Inventory reserved: ${body}"
- route:
    id: process-payment
    from:
      uri: "direct:process-payment"
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "http:payment-service:8080/api/charge"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - log:
            message: "Payment processed: ${body}"
- route:
    id: cancel-order-compensation
    from:
      uri: "direct:cancel-order"
      steps:
        - log:
            message: "COMPENSATING: Cancelling order ${header.orderId}"
        - to:
            uri: "http:inventory-service:8080/api/release"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - to:
            uri: "http:payment-service:8080/api/refund"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - log:
            message: "Compensation complete: inventory released, payment refunded"

flows.name: saga-travel-booking
flows.description: Travel booking saga: flight + hotel + car with full compensation chain
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: saga-travel-booking
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/bookings/travel"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: bookingId
            simple: "${exchangeId}"
        - saga:
            propagation: REQUIRED
            timeout: 120s
            compensation:
              uri: "direct:compensate-travel"
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:book-flight"
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:book-hotel"
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:book-car"
              - to:
                  uri: "saga:complete"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"bookingId":"${exchangeProperty.bookingId}","status":"CONFIRMED"}'
- route:
    id: book-flight
    from:
      uri: "direct:book-flight"
      steps:
        - setHeader:
            name: Content-Type
            constant: "application/json"
        - to:
            uri: "http:flight-service:8080/api/flights/book"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - setProperty:
            name: flightConfirmation
            simple: "${body}"
        - log:
            message: "Flight booked: ${body}"
- route:
    id: book-hotel
    from:
      uri: "direct:book-hotel"
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "http:hotel-service:8080/api/hotels/reserve"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - setProperty:
            name: hotelConfirmation
            simple: "${body}"
        - log:
            message: "Hotel booked: ${body}"
- route:
    id: book-car
    from:
      uri: "direct:book-car"
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "http:car-service:8080/api/cars/reserve"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - log:
            message: "Car booked: ${body}"
- route:
    id: compensate-travel
    from:
      uri: "direct:compensate-travel"
      steps:
        - log:
            message: "COMPENSATING travel booking ${exchangeProperty.bookingId}"
        - doTry:
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "http:flight-service:8080/api/flights/cancel"
                  parameters:
                    httpMethod: POST
            doCatch:
              - exception:
                  - "java.lang.Exception"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Flight cancellation failed, will retry"
        - doTry:
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "http:hotel-service:8080/api/hotels/cancel"
                  parameters:
                    httpMethod: POST
            doCatch:
              - exception:
                  - "java.lang.Exception"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Hotel cancellation failed, will retry"
        - to:
            uri: "http:car-service:8080/api/cars/cancel"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - log:
            message: "Travel compensation complete"

flows.name: saga-money-transfer
flows.description: Bank money transfer saga with debit/credit and rollback
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: saga-money-transfer
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/transfers"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: fromAccount
            simple: "${body[fromAccount]}"
        - setProperty:
            name: toAccount
            simple: "${body[toAccount]}"
        - setProperty:
            name: amount
            simple: "${body[amount]}"
        - saga:
            propagation: REQUIRED
            timeout: 30s
            compensation:
              uri: "direct:reverse-transfer"
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:debit-account"
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:credit-account"
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:record-transfer"
              - to:
                  uri: "saga:complete"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"status":"COMPLETED","transferId":"${exchangeId}"}'
- route:
    id: debit-account
    from:
      uri: "direct:debit-account"
      steps:
        - setBody:
            simple: "UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - ${exchangeProperty.amount} WHERE account_id = '${exchangeProperty.fromAccount}' AND balance >= ${exchangeProperty.amount}"
        - to:
            uri: "sql:dummy"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#bankDataSource"
        - log:
            message: "Debited ${exchangeProperty.amount} from ${exchangeProperty.fromAccount}"
- route:
    id: credit-account
    from:

    id: cb-retry-timeout
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/orders/{id}"
      steps:
        - circuitBreaker:
            resilience4jConfiguration:
              failureRateThreshold: 40
              waitDurationInOpenState: 45000
              slidingWindowSize: 15
              minimumNumberOfCalls: 5
              automaticTransitionFromOpenToHalfOpenEnabled: true
            steps:
              - doTry:
                  steps:
                    - toD:
                        uri: "http:order-service:8080/api/orders/${header.id}"
                        parameters:
                          httpMethod: GET
                          connectTimeout: 2000
                          socketTimeout: 8000
                  doCatch:
                    - exception:
                        - "java.net.SocketTimeoutException"
                        - "org.apache.camel.http.base.HttpOperationFailedException"
                      steps:
                        - log:
                            message: "Retry attempt for order ${header.id}"
                        - delay:
                            expression:
                              constant: "1000"
                        - toD:
                            uri: "http:order-service:8080/api/orders/${header.id}"
                            parameters:
                              httpMethod: GET
                              connectTimeout: 3000
                              socketTimeout: 12000
            onFallback:
              steps:
                - setBody:
                    constant: '{"error":"Service temporarily unavailable","retryAfter":45}'
                - setHeader:
                    name: CamelHttpResponseCode
                    constant: "503"
                - setHeader:
                    name: Retry-After
                    constant: "45"

              slidingWindowSize: 5
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "http:api.exchangerates.io/latest"
                  parameters:
                    httpMethod: GET
              - unmarshal:
                  json:
                    library: jackson
              - setProperty:
                  name: latestRates
                  simple: "${body}"
              - log:
                  message: "Exchange rates updated: ${body[rates][USD]}"
            onFallback:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "Exchange rate API unavailable - using last known rates"
                - setBody:
                    constant: '{"source":"cache","stale":true}'

flows.name: cb-grpc-service
flows.description: gRPC service call with circuit breaker and local computation fallback
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cb-grpc-service
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/pricing/calculate"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - circuitBreaker:
            resilience4jConfiguration:
              failureRateThreshold: 40
              waitDurationInOpenState: 30000
              slidingWindowSize: 20
              slowCallDurationThreshold: 2000
              slowCallRateThreshold: 60
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "grpc:pricing-service:50051/PricingService/calculatePrice"
                  parameters:
                    synchronous: true
              - log:
                  message: "Price calculated via gRPC service"
            onFallback:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "Pricing service circuit OPEN - using base price calculation"
                - bean:
                    ref: "#localPricingCalculator"
                    method: "calculateBasePrice"
                - setHeader:
                    name: X-Price-Source
                    constant: "local-calculation"

flows.name: cb-cascading-protection
flows.description: Cascading circuit breakers preventing failure propagation
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cb-cascading-protection
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/checkout"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - circuitBreaker:
            id: checkout-outer-circuit
            resilience4jConfiguration:
              failureRateThreshold: 30
              waitDurationInOpenState: 60000
              slidingWindowSize: 10
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:validate-cart"
              - circuitBreaker:
                  id: payment-inner-circuit
                  resilience4jConfiguration:
                    failureRateThreshold: 20
                    waitDurationInOpenState: 90000
                    slidingWindowSize: 5
                  steps:
                    - to:
                        uri: "http:payment-gateway:443/api/process"
                        parameters:
                          httpMethod: POST
                  onFallback:
                    steps:
                      - log:
                          message: "Payment gateway offline - queueing"
                      - to:
                          uri: "direct:queue-payment"
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:confirm-checkout"
            onFallback:
              steps:
                - setBody:
                    constant: '{"error":"Checkout service is currently degraded. Please try again in a few minutes.","retryAfter":60}'
                - setHeader:
                    name: CamelHttpResponseCode
                    constant: "503"

flows.name: cbr-order-priority
flows.description: Route orders to different queues based on priority and value
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cbr-order-priority
    from:
      uri: "kafka:incoming-orders"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: order-router
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - choice:
            when:
              - jsonpath: "$[?(@.priority == 'CRITICAL' && @.value > 10000)]"
                steps:
                  - setHeader:
                      name: routeTarget
                      constant: "vip-processing"
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:vip-orders"
              - jsonpath: "$[?(@.priority == 'HIGH')]"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:high-priority-orders"
              - jsonpath: "$[?(@.value > 5000)]"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:high-value-orders"
              - simple: "${body[region]} == 'EU'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:eu-orders"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - to:
                    uri: "direct:standard-orders"
        - log:
            message: "Order routed to ${header.routeTarget}"

flows.name: cbr-file-type-processor
flows.description: Route files to different processors based on extension and size
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cbr-file-type-processor
    from:
      uri: "file:/opt/intake"
      parameters:
        noop: true
        recursive: true
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${header.CamelFileName} regex '.*\\.csv$'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:process-csv"
              - simple: "${header.CamelFileName} regex '.*\\.json$'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:process-json"
              - simple: "${header.CamelFileName} regex '.*\\.(xml|xsd)$'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:process-xml"
              - simple: "${header.CamelFileName} regex '.*\\.pdf$' && ${header.CamelFileLength} > 10000000"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:process-large-pdf"
              - simple: "${header.CamelFileName} regex '.*\\.pdf$'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:process-pdf"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "Unknown file type: ${header.CamelFileName}"
                - to:
                    uri: "file:/opt/intake/unprocessed"

flows.name: cbr-http-content-type
flows.description: Route HTTP requests based on Content-Type and Accept headers
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cbr-http-content-type
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/transform"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${header.Content-Type} contains 'application/json' && ${header.Accept} contains 'application/xml'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:json-to-xml"
              - simple: "${header.Content-Type} contains 'application/xml' && ${header.Accept} contains 'application/json'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:xml-to-json"
              - simple: "${header.Content-Type} contains 'text/csv'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:csv-to-json"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - setHeader:
                    name: CamelHttpResponseCode
                    constant: "415"
                - setBody:
                    constant: '{"error":"Unsupported media type combination"}'

flows.name: cbr-dynamic-router
flows.description: Dynamic routing based on runtime rules loaded from database
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cbr-dynamic-router
    from:
      uri: "kafka:events"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: dynamic-router
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: eventType
            simple: "${body[type]}"
        - toD:
            uri: "sql:SELECT target_endpoint FROM routing_rules WHERE event_type = :#${exchangeProperty.eventType} AND active = true"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#routingDb"
              outputType: SelectOne
        - setProperty:
            name: targetEndpoint
            simple: "${body[target_endpoint]}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.targetEndpoint} != null"
                steps:
                  - toD:
                      uri: "${exchangeProperty.targetEndpoint}"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "No routing rule for event type: ${exchangeProperty.eventType}"
                - to:
                    uri: "kafka:unrouted-events"
                    parameters:
                      brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"

flows.name: cbr-geo-router
flows.description: Route requests to regional services based on geolocation
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cbr-geo-router
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/service"
      steps:
        - setProperty:

                steps:

              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.clientRegion} in 'EU-WEST,EU-CENTRAL,UK'"

                      uri: "http:eu-service.internal:8080/api/process"

                        httpMethod: POST

                  - to:
                      uri: "http:apac-service.internal:8080/api/process"

                        httpMethod: POST

                - to:
                    uri: "http:global-service.internal:8080/api/process"

                      httpMethod: POST
        - log:
            message: "Request routed for region: ${exchangeProperty.clientRegion}"

flows.name: cbr-message-version
flows.description: Route messages to version-specific processors based on schema version
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cbr-message-version
    from:
      uri: "kafka:api-events"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: version-router
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: schemaVersion
            simple: "${body[version]}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.schemaVersion} == '3.0'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:process-v3"
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.schemaVersion} == '2.0'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:transform-v2-to-v3"
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:process-v3"
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.schemaVersion} == '1.0'"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Legacy v1 message - applying full migration"
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:transform-v1-to-v3"
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:process-v3"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "Unknown schema version: ${exchangeProperty.schemaVersion}"
                    loggingLevel: WARN
                - to:
                    uri: "kafka:dead-letter-events"
                    parameters:
                      brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"

flows.name: cbr-error-handler-type
flows.description: Route errors to different handlers based on error type and severity
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cbr-error-handler-type
    from:
      uri: "kafka:application-errors"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: error-router
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${body[severity]} == 'CRITICAL' && ${body[type]} == 'SECURITY'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:security-incident"
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:page-on-call"
              - simple: "${body[severity]} == 'CRITICAL'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:page-on-call"
              - simple: "${body[type]} == 'PERFORMANCE'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:performance-alert"
              - simple: "${body[type]} == 'BUSINESS_LOGIC'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:business-error-handler"
              - simple: "${body[retryable]} == true"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "kafka:retry-queue"
                      parameters:
                        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - to:
                    uri: "direct:log-and-archive"

flows.name: cbr-tenant-router
flows.description: Multi-tenant request routing based on tenant ID and subscription tier
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:

    from:

      steps:

        - setProperty:

        - choice:

              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.tier} == 'ENTERPRISE'"
                steps:

                      uri: "http:dedicated-cluster.internal:8080/api/data"

flows.name: cbr-payload-size-router
flows.description: Route payloads to different processing paths based on size
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cbr-payload-size-router
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/upload"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: payloadSize
            simple: "${header.Content-Length}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.payloadSize} > 104857600"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Large payload (>100MB) - streaming to S3"
                  - to:
                      uri: "aws2-s3:large-uploads"
                      parameters:
                        region: us-east-1
                        multiPartUpload: true
                        partSize: 26214400
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.payloadSize} > 1048576"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Medium payload (>1MB) - async processing"
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:async-process"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "Small payload - inline processing"
                - to:
                    uri: "direct:inline-process"

flows.name: cbr-recipient-list

flows.name: cbr-xpath-xml-router

flows.name: cbr-header-based

        - choice:

                      uri: "direct:handle-user-created"

                steps:

                      uri: "direct:handle-user-updated"

                steps:

                      uri: "direct:handle-order-placed"

                steps:

                      uri: "direct:handle-payment-received"
              - simple: "${header.eventType} == 'INVENTORY_LOW'"

            otherwise:

flows.name: cbr-weighted-loadbalancer
flows.description: Weighted load balancing with content-based routing for A/B testing
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cbr-weighted-loadbalancer
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/feature"
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: userId
            simple: "${header.X-User-ID}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.userId.hashCode() % 100} < 10"
                steps:
                  - setHeader:
                      name: X-Variant
                      constant: "canary"
                  - to:
                      uri: "http:service-v2:8080/api/feature"
                      parameters:
                        httpMethod: GET
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.userId.hashCode() % 100} < 50"
                steps:
                  - setHeader:
                      name: X-Variant
                      constant: "beta"
                  - to:
                      uri: "http:service-v1-beta:8080/api/feature"
                      parameters:
                        httpMethod: GET
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - setHeader:
                    name: X-Variant
                    constant: "stable"
                - to:
                    uri: "http:service-v1:8080/api/feature"
                    parameters:
                      httpMethod: GET

flows.name: cbr-time-based
flows.description: Route requests based on time of day for capacity management
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: cbr-time-based
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/process"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${date:now:HH} >= 9 && ${date:now:HH} < 17"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Business hours - real-time processing"
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:realtime-process"
              - simple: "${date:now:HH} >= 17 && ${date:now:HH} < 22"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Evening - batch processing"
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:batch-queue"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "Off-hours - deferred processing"
                - to:
                    uri: "direct:deferred-queue"

flows.name: cbr-jsonpath-complex

- route:

        groupId: txn-router
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - choice:

                      message: "High-value USD transaction - compliance check required"

flows.name: event-kafka-to-elasticsearch

flows.name: event-cqrs-command
flows.description: CQRS command side: validate command, emit event, update read model

            uri: "kafka:order-events"
            parameters:
              brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        - setBody:

- route:
    id: event-cqrs-read-model
    from:
      uri: "kafka:order-events"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: read-model-updater
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - to:

        - log:
            message: "Read model updated for order: ${body[orderId]}"

flows.name: event-sourcing-aggregate
flows.description: Event sourcing: store events, replay to rebuild aggregate state
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: event-sourcing-store
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/aggregates/{aggregateId}/events"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: aggregateId
            simple: "${header.aggregateId}"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"aggregateId":"${exchangeProperty.aggregateId}","eventData":${body},"sequence":${date:now:yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS},"createdAt":"${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}"}'
        - to:
            uri: "mongodb:eventStore"
            parameters:
              database: event_store
              collection: events
              operation: insert
        - to:
            uri: "kafka:aggregate-events"
            parameters:
              brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"stored":true,"aggregateId":"${exchangeProperty.aggregateId}"}'

    id: event-sourcing-replay
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/aggregates/{aggregateId}/state"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: GET
      steps:
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"aggregateId":"${header.aggregateId}"}'
        - to:
            uri: "mongodb:eventStore"
            parameters:
              database: event_store
              collection: events
              operation: findAll
        - bean:
            ref: "#aggregateRebuilder"
            method: "rebuild"
        - marshal:
            json:
              library: jackson

flows.name: event-debezium-cdc

flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:

flows.name: event-outbox-pattern

flows.name: event-kafka-streams-aggregate

flows.name: event-webhook-fan-out

flows.name: event-dead-letter-processor
flows.description: Dead letter queue processor with retry and permanent failure handling
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: event-dead-letter-processor
    from:
      uri: "kafka:dead-letter-queue"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: dlq-processor
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: retryCount
            simple: "${body[retryCount]}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.retryCount} < 3"
                steps:
                  - delay:
                      expression:
                        simple: "${exchangeProperty.retryCount} * 5000"
                  - setBody:
                      simple: "${body[originalPayload]}"
                  - toD:
                      uri: "${body[originalEndpoint]}"
                  - log:
                      message: "DLQ message reprocessed successfully"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "Permanent failure after 3 retries - archiving"
                - to:
                    uri: "sql:INSERT INTO failed_events (payload, error, created_at) VALUES (:#${body}, :#${body[error]}, NOW())"
                    parameters:
                      dataSource: "#mainDataSource"

flows.name: event-saga-event-choreography

flows.name: event-amqp-processor

flows.name: event-idempotent-consumer

flows.name: event-knative-cloudevent

flows.name: event-kafka-exactly-once

flows.name: event-scatter-gather

flows.name: gw-rest-aggregation

flows.name: gw-rate-limiter
flows.description: API gateway with rate limiting per client using throttle EIP
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: gw-rate-limiter
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/v1/{path}"
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: clientId
            simple: "${header.X-API-Key}"
        - setProperty:
            name: path
            simple: "${header.path}"
        - throttle:
            expression:
              constant: "100"
            timePeriodMillis: 60000
            rejectExecution: true
            correlationExpression:
              simple: "${exchangeProperty.clientId}"
        - removeHeaders:
            pattern: "X-Internal-*"
        - setHeader:
            name: X-Request-ID
            simple: "${exchangeId}"
        - setHeader:
            name: X-Forwarded-For
            simple: "${header.Host}"
        - toD:
            uri: "http:backend-service:8080/${exchangeProperty.path}"
        - setHeader:
            name: X-RateLimit-Remaining
            constant: "computed-at-runtime"

            message: "Gateway: ${exchangeProperty.clientId} -> /${exchangeProperty.path}"

flows.name: gw-auth-proxy
flows.description: API gateway with JWT validation and header enrichment
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: gw-auth-proxy
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/secure/{path}"
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: authToken
            simple: "${header.Authorization}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.authToken} == null || ${exchangeProperty.authToken} == ''"
                steps:
                  - setHeader:
                      name: CamelHttpResponseCode
                      constant: "401"
                  - setBody:
                      constant: '{"error":"Missing authorization header"}'
                  - stop: {}
        - to:
            uri: "http:auth-service:8080/api/validate-token"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${body[valid]} == false"
                steps:
                  - setHeader:
                      name: CamelHttpResponseCode
                      constant: "403"
                  - setBody:
                      constant: '{"error":"Invalid or expired token"}'
                  - stop: {}
        - setHeader:
            name: X-User-ID
            simple: "${body[userId]}"
        - setHeader:
            name: X-User-Roles
            simple: "${body[roles]}"
        - toD:
            uri: "http:backend-service:8080/api/${header.path}"

flows.name: gw-response-cache

flows.kaotoDesign:

    id: gw-response-cache
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/cached/{resource}"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: GET
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: cacheKey
            simple: "cache:${header.resource}:${header.CamelHttpQuery}"
        - setHeader:
            name: CamelRedis.Key
            simple: "${exchangeProperty.cacheKey}"
        - to:
            uri: "spring-redis:api-cache"
            parameters:
              command: GET
              host: redis-server
              port: 6379
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${body} != null"
                steps:
                  - setHeader:
                      name: X-Cache
                      constant: "HIT"
                  - log:
                      message: "Cache HIT: ${exchangeProperty.cacheKey}"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - setHeader:
                    name: X-Cache
                    constant: "MISS"
                - toD:
                    uri: "http:backend-service:8080/api/${header.resource}"
                - setHeader:
                    name: CamelRedis.Key
                    simple: "${exchangeProperty.cacheKey}"
                - to:
                    uri: "spring-redis:api-cache"
                    parameters:
                      command: SETEX
                      host: redis-server
                      port: 6379
                - log:
                    message: "Cache MISS - stored: ${exchangeProperty.cacheKey}"

flows.name: gw-request-transform

flows.name: gw-circuit-breaker-lb

flows.name: gw-graphql-rest-bridge

        - setHeader:

flows.name: gw-api-composition

flows.name: etl-csv-to-database

            parallelProcessing: true
            steps:

                    dataSource: "#mainDataSource"
        - log:
            message: "CSV import completed: ${header.CamelFileName}"

flows.name: etl-json-transform-load
flows.description: Stream JSON events, transform schema, and load to MongoDB
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-json-transform-load
    from:
      uri: "kafka:raw-events"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: etl-loader
        maxPollRecords: 200
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - to:
            uri: "jolt:specs/event-transform.json"
            parameters:
              transformDsl: Shift
              inputType: JsonString
              outputType: JsonString
        - setProperty:
            name: collectionName
            simple: "events_${date:now:yyyy_MM}"
        - toD:
            uri: "mongodb:analyticsDb"
            parameters:
              database: analytics
              collection: "${exchangeProperty.collectionName}"
              operation: insert
        - log:
            message: "Event loaded to MongoDB: ${exchangeProperty.collectionName}"

flows.name: etl-database-sync
flows.description: Periodic database extract, transform, and sync to external system
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-database-sync
    from:
      uri: "timer:db-sync"
      parameters:
        period: 300000
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "sql:SELECT * FROM orders WHERE synced = false AND created_at > :#${date:now-1h:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#sourceDataSource"
              outputType: SelectList
        - split:
            expression:
              simple: "${body}"
            steps:
              - marshal:
                  json:
                    library: jackson
              - to:
                  uri: "http:external-system:8080/api/sync/orders"
                  parameters:
                    httpMethod: POST
              - to:
                  uri: "sql:UPDATE orders SET synced = true WHERE id = :#${body[id]}"
                  parameters:
                    dataSource: "#sourceDataSource"
        - log:
            message: "Database sync batch completed"

flows.name: etl-s3-data-lake
flows.description: Stream Kafka events to S3 data lake in partitioned Parquet-like format
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-s3-data-lake
    from:
      uri: "kafka:all-events"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: data-lake-writer
        maxPollRecords: 1000
      steps:
        - aggregate:
            aggregationStrategy: "#batchAggregator"
            correlationExpression:
              constant: "batch"
            completionSize: 500
            completionTimeout: 30000
            steps:
              - marshal:
                  json:
                    library: jackson
              - setHeader:
                  name: CamelAwsS3Key
                  simple: "raw/year=${date:now:yyyy}/month=${date:now:MM}/day=${date:now:dd}/hour=${date:now:HH}/batch-${exchangeId}.json"
              - to:
                  uri: "aws2-s3:data-lake-bucket"
                  parameters:
                    region: us-east-1
              - log:
                  message: "Data lake batch written: ${header.CamelAwsS3Key}"

flows.name: etl-xml-to-json-enriched
flows.description: XML file processing with XSLT transformation, API enrichment, and Kafka output
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-xml-to-json-enriched
    from:
      uri: "file:/opt/data/xml-inbox"
      parameters:
        include: ".*\\.xml"
        move: ".processed"
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "xslt:transforms/normalize.xsl"
        - unmarshal:
            jacksonXml: {}
        - split:
            expression:
              jsonpath: "$.records[*]"
            steps:
              - setProperty:
                  name: recordId
                  simple: "${body[id]}"
              - enrich:
                  expression:
                    simple: "http:enrichment-api:8080/api/lookup/${exchangeProperty.recordId}"
                  aggregationStrategy: "#mergeEnrichment"
              - marshal:
                  json:
                    library: jackson
              - to:
                  uri: "kafka:enriched-records"
                  parameters:
                    brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        - log:
            message: "XML file processed and enriched: ${header.CamelFileName}"

flows.name: etl-split-aggregate-report
flows.description: Extract data, split by region, aggregate totals, generate report
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-split-aggregate-report
    from:
      uri: "quartz:daily-report?cron=0+0+6+*+*+?"
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "sql:SELECT region, category, SUM(amount) as total, COUNT(*) as count FROM transactions WHERE date = CURRENT_DATE - 1 GROUP BY region, category"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#reportDataSource"
              outputType: SelectList
        - aggregate:
            aggregationStrategy: "#reportAggregator"
            correlationExpression:
              constant: "daily-report"
            completionSize: 1
            completionTimeout: 5000
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "freemarker:templates/daily-report.ftl"
              - setHeader:
                  name: To
                  constant: "reports@company.com"
              - setHeader:
                  name: Subject
                  simple: "Daily Report - ${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd}"
              - to:
                  uri: "smtp:mail-server:587"
        - log:
            message: "Daily report generated and emailed"

flows.name: etl-multiformat-ingest
flows.description: Ingest files in multiple formats (CSV, JSON, XML) and normalize to DB
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-multiformat-ingest
    from:
      uri: "file:/opt/data/multi-format"
      parameters:
        recursive: true
        move: ".done/${date:now:yyyyMMdd}"
      steps:
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${header.CamelFileName} regex '.*\\.csv$'"
                steps:
                  - unmarshal:
                      csv:
                        useMaps: true
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:normalize-and-load"
              - simple: "${header.CamelFileName} regex '.*\\.json$'"
                steps:
                  - unmarshal:
                      json:
                        library: jackson
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:normalize-and-load"
              - simple: "${header.CamelFileName} regex '.*\\.xml$'"
                steps:
                  - unmarshal:
                      jacksonXml: {}
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:normalize-and-load"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "Unsupported format: ${header.CamelFileName}"
- route:
    id: normalize-and-load
    from:
      uri: "direct:normalize-and-load"
      steps:
        - split:
            expression:
              simple: "${body}"
            steps:
              - bean:
                  ref: "#dataNormalizer"
                  method: "normalize"
              - to:
                  uri: "sql:INSERT INTO normalized_data (source, data, ingested_at) VALUES (:#${header.CamelFileName}, :#${body}, NOW())"
                  parameters:
                    dataSource: "#mainDataSource"

flows.name: etl-incremental-load
flows.description: Incremental ETL loading using watermark-based change detection
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-incremental-load
    from:
      uri: "timer:incremental-etl"
      parameters:
        period: 60000
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "sql:SELECT watermark_value FROM etl_state WHERE job_name = 'product-sync'"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#etlStateDb"
              outputType: SelectOne
        - setProperty:
            name: lastWatermark
            simple: "${body[watermark_value]}"
        - toD:
            uri: "sql:SELECT * FROM products WHERE updated_at > :#${exchangeProperty.lastWatermark} ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT 1000"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#sourceDataSource"
              outputType: SelectList
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${body.size()} > 0"
                steps:
                  - split:
                      expression:
                        simple: "${body}"
                      steps:
                        - marshal:
                            json:
                              library: jackson
                        - to:
                            uri: "mongodb:targetDb"
                            parameters:
                              database: products
                              collection: product_catalog
                              operation: save
                  - to:
                      uri: "sql:UPDATE etl_state SET watermark_value = :#${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} WHERE job_name = 'product-sync'"
                      parameters:
                        dataSource: "#etlStateDb"
        - log:
            message: "Incremental ETL cycle completed"

flows.name: etl-data-quality-check
flows.description: ETL pipeline with data quality validation and quarantine
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-data-quality-check
    from:
      uri: "kafka:raw-data"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: data-quality
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - bean:
            ref: "#dataQualityValidator"
            method: "validate"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${header.validationResult} == 'PASSED'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "kafka:clean-data"
                      parameters:
                        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
              - simple: "${header.validationResult} == 'FIXABLE'"
                steps:
                  - bean:
                      ref: "#dataFixer"
                      method: "fix"
                  - to:
                      uri: "kafka:clean-data"
                      parameters:
                        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - to:
                    uri: "kafka:quarantine-data"
                    parameters:
                      brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
                - to:
                    uri: "sql:INSERT INTO data_quality_issues (record_id, issue, raw_data) VALUES (:#${body[id]}, :#${header.validationIssue}, :#${body})"
                    parameters:
                      dataSource: "#qualityDb"
        - log:
            message: "Data quality check: ${header.validationResult}"

flows.name: etl-api-to-warehouse
flows.description: Extract from REST API, transform and load into data warehouse
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-api-to-warehouse
    from:
      uri: "timer:api-extract"
      parameters:
        period: 3600000
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: page
            constant: "1"
        - loopDoWhile:
            expression:
              simple: "${exchangeProperty.hasMore} != 'false'"
            steps:
              - toD:
                  uri: "http:source-api:8080/api/records?page=${exchangeProperty.page}&limit=100"
              - unmarshal:
                  json:
                    library: jackson
              - setProperty:
                  name: hasMore
                  simple: "${body[hasMore]}"
              - split:
                  expression:
                    jsonpath: "$.data[*]"
                  steps:
                    - to:
                        uri: "sql:INSERT INTO warehouse.records (ext_id, data, loaded_at) VALUES (:#${body[id]}, :#${body}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (ext_id) DO UPDATE SET data = :#${body}"
                        parameters:
                          dataSource: "#warehouseDataSource"
              - setProperty:
                  name: page
                  simple: "${exchangeProperty.page.toInteger() + 1}"
        - log:
            message: "API extraction completed - ${exchangeProperty.page} pages loaded"

flows.name: etl-deduplication-pipeline
flows.description: ETL pipeline with Redis-based deduplication before loading
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-deduplication-pipeline
    from:
      uri: "kafka:incoming-records"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: dedup-pipeline
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: recordHash
            simple: "${body[id]}-${body[checksum]}"
        - idempotentConsumer:
            expression:
              simple: "${exchangeProperty.recordHash}"
            idempotentRepository: "#redisDeduplicationRepo"
            skipDuplicate: true
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:transform-and-load"
              - log:
                  message: "New record loaded: ${exchangeProperty.recordHash}"

flows.name: etl-parallel-enrichment
flows.description: Parallel enrichment from multiple sources before loading
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-parallel-enrichment
    from:
      uri: "kafka:raw-customers"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: customer-enrichment
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: customerId
            simple: "${body[id]}"
        - multicast:
            aggregationStrategy: "#customerEnrichmentMerger"
            parallelProcessing: true
            timeout: 5000
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:enrich-from-crm"
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:enrich-from-billing"
              - to:
                  uri: "direct:enrich-from-support"
        - to:
            uri: "sql:INSERT INTO enriched_customers (id, data, enriched_at) VALUES (:#${exchangeProperty.customerId}, :#${body}, NOW())"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#warehouseDataSource"
- route:
    id: enrich-from-crm
    from:
      uri: "direct:enrich-from-crm"
      steps:
        - toD:
            uri: "http:crm-service:8080/api/customers/${exchangeProperty.customerId}"
- route:
    id: enrich-from-billing
    from:
      uri: "direct:enrich-from-billing"
      steps:
        - toD:
            uri: "http:billing-service:8080/api/customers/${exchangeProperty.customerId}/summary"

flows.name: etl-slow-changing-dimension
flows.description: Slowly changing dimension Type 2 ETL for data warehouse
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-slow-changing-dimension
    from:
      uri: "timer:scd-update"
      parameters:
        period: 86400000
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "sql:SELECT * FROM staging.customers WHERE processed = false"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#stagingDataSource"
              outputType: SelectList
        - split:
            expression:
              simple: "${body}"
            steps:
              - setProperty:
                  name: customerId
                  simple: "${body[customer_id]}"
              - toD:
                  uri: "sql:SELECT * FROM warehouse.dim_customer WHERE customer_id = :#${exchangeProperty.customerId} AND is_current = true"
                  parameters:
                    dataSource: "#warehouseDataSource"
                    outputType: SelectOne
              - choice:
                  when:
                    - simple: "${body} != null && ${body[hash]} != ${exchangeProperty.newHash}"
                      steps:
                        - to:
                            uri: "sql:UPDATE warehouse.dim_customer SET is_current = false, valid_to = NOW() WHERE customer_id = :#${exchangeProperty.customerId} AND is_current = true"
                            parameters:
                              dataSource: "#warehouseDataSource"
                        - to:
                            uri: "sql:INSERT INTO warehouse.dim_customer (customer_id, data, valid_from, is_current) VALUES (:#${exchangeProperty.customerId}, :#${body}, NOW(), true)"
                            parameters:
                              dataSource: "#warehouseDataSource"
        - log:
            message: "SCD Type 2 processing completed"

flows.name: etl-streaming-window
flows.description: Time-windowed aggregation of streaming data for analytics
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-streaming-window
    from:
      uri: "kafka:clickstream"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: window-aggregator
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - aggregate:
            aggregationStrategy: "#windowedCountStrategy"
            correlationExpression:
              simple: "${body[pageId]}"
            completionInterval: 60000
            steps:
              - to:
                  uri: "sql:INSERT INTO page_metrics (page_id, view_count, unique_visitors, window_start, window_end) VALUES (:#${body[pageId]}, :#${body[viewCount]}, :#${body[uniqueVisitors]}, :#${body[windowStart]}, :#${body[windowEnd]})"
                  parameters:
                    dataSource: "#analyticsDataSource"
              - log:
                  message: "Window aggregate stored for page: ${body[pageId]}"

flows.name: etl-file-merge-dedupe
flows.description: Merge multiple input files, deduplicate records, output clean dataset
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: etl-file-merge-dedupe
    from:
      uri: "file:/opt/data/merge-inbox"
      parameters:
        include: ".*\\.csv"
        sortBy: "file:name"
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            csv:
              useMaps: true
        - split:
            expression:
              simple: "${body}"
            steps:
              - setProperty:
                  name: dedupeKey
                  simple: "${body[email]}-${body[phone]}"
              - idempotentConsumer:
                  expression:
                    simple: "${exchangeProperty.dedupeKey}"
                  idempotentRepository: "#memoryDedupeRepo"
                  steps:
                    - to:
                        uri: "sql:INSERT INTO merged_records (email, phone, name, source_file) VALUES (:#${body[email]}, :#${body[phone]}, :#${body[name]}, :#${header.CamelFileName})"
                        parameters:
                          dataSource: "#mainDataSource"
        - log:
            message: "File merged and deduplicated: ${header.CamelFileName}"

flows.name: iot-mqtt-sensor-pipeline
flows.description: MQTT sensor data ingestion with validation and time-series storage
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: iot-mqtt-sensor-pipeline
    from:
      uri: "paho-mqtt5:sensors/+/temperature"
      parameters:
        brokerUrl: "tcp://mqtt-broker:1883"
        qos: 1
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: sensorId
            simple: "${header.CamelMqttTopic}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${body[value]} < -50 || ${body[value]} > 150"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Invalid reading from ${exchangeProperty.sensorId}: ${body[value]}"
                      loggingLevel: WARN
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:invalid-readings"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - setBody:
                    simple: "temperature,sensor=${exchangeProperty.sensorId} value=${body[value]} ${body[timestamp]}"
                - to:
                    uri: "influxdb:influxConnection"
                    parameters:
                      databaseName: iot_metrics
                      retentionPolicy: autogen
                - log:
                    message: "Sensor reading stored: ${exchangeProperty.sensorId}=${body[value]}"

flows.name: iot-alert-threshold
flows.description: IoT threshold monitoring with multi-channel alerting
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: iot-alert-threshold
    from:
      uri: "paho-mqtt5:sensors/#"
      parameters:
        brokerUrl: "tcp://mqtt-broker:1883"
        qos: 1
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: sensorId
            simple: "${body[sensorId]}"
        - setProperty:
            name: value
            simple: "${body[value]}"
        - setProperty:
            name: threshold
            simple: "${body[threshold]}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.value} > ${exchangeProperty.threshold}"
                steps:
                  - setBody:
                      simple: ":warning: *IoT Alert*\nSensor: ${exchangeProperty.sensorId}\nValue: ${exchangeProperty.value} (threshold: ${exchangeProperty.threshold})\nTime: ${date:now:HH:mm:ss}"
                  - multicast:
                      parallelProcessing: true
                      steps:
                        - to:
                            uri: "slack:#iot-alerts"
                            parameters:
                              webhookUrl: "{{slack.iot.webhook}}"
                        - to:
                            uri: "direct:iot-email-alert"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "Sensor ${exchangeProperty.sensorId} normal: ${exchangeProperty.value}"

flows.name: iot-device-telemetry-batch
flows.description: Batch IoT telemetry from MQTT, buffer in Kafka, archive to S3
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: iot-device-telemetry-batch
    from:
      uri: "paho-mqtt5:devices/+/telemetry"
      parameters:
        brokerUrl: "tcp://mqtt-broker:1883"
        qos: 1
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "kafka:device-telemetry"
            parameters:
              brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
- route:
    id: iot-telemetry-archiver
    from:
      uri: "kafka:device-telemetry"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: telemetry-archiver
        maxPollRecords: 1000
      steps:
        - aggregate:
            aggregationStrategy: "#telemetryBatchStrategy"
            correlationExpression:
              constant: "telemetry-batch"
            completionSize: 500
            completionTimeout: 60000
            steps:
              - marshal:
                  json:
                    library: jackson
              - setHeader:
                  name: CamelAwsS3Key
                  simple: "telemetry/${date:now:yyyy/MM/dd/HH}/batch-${exchangeId}.json.gz"
              - to:
                  uri: "aws2-s3:iot-telemetry-archive"
                  parameters:
                    region: us-east-1
              - log:
                  message: "Telemetry batch archived: ${header.CamelAwsS3Key}"

flows.name: iot-opcua-to-kafka
flows.description: OPC-UA industrial data subscription to Kafka for real-time analytics
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: iot-opcua-to-kafka
    from:
      uri: "milo-client:opc.tcp://plc-server:4840"
      parameters:
        node: "ns=2;s=Machine1.Temperature"
        samplingInterval: 1000
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: nodeId
            simple: "${header.CamelMiloNodeId}"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"nodeId":"${exchangeProperty.nodeId}","value":${body},"timestamp":"${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS}","quality":"GOOD"}'
        - to:
            uri: "kafka:industrial-data"
            parameters:
              brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        - log:
            message: "OPC-UA data published: ${exchangeProperty.nodeId} = ${body}"

flows.name: iot-geofence-monitor
flows.description: GPS tracking with geofence violation detection
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: iot-geofence-monitor
    from:
      uri: "paho-mqtt5:fleet/+/gps"
      parameters:
        brokerUrl: "tcp://mqtt-broker:1883"
        qos: 1
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: vehicleId
            simple: "${body[vehicleId]}"
        - setProperty:
            name: latitude
            simple: "${body[lat]}"
        - setProperty:
            name: longitude
            simple: "${body[lng]}"
        - bean:
            ref: "#geofenceChecker"
            method: "isInsideGeofence"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${body} == false"
                steps:
                  - setBody:
                      simple: '{"event":"GEOFENCE_VIOLATION","vehicleId":"${exchangeProperty.vehicleId}","lat":${exchangeProperty.latitude},"lng":${exchangeProperty.longitude},"time":"${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}"}'
                  - to:
                      uri: "kafka:geofence-violations"
                      parameters:
                        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
                  - log:
                      message: "GEOFENCE VIOLATION: Vehicle ${exchangeProperty.vehicleId}"

flows.name: iot-windowed-aggregation
flows.description: Tumbling window aggregation of sensor data for minute-level metrics
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: iot-windowed-aggregation
    from:
      uri: "paho-mqtt5:sensors/+/power"
      parameters:
        brokerUrl: "tcp://mqtt-broker:1883"
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - aggregate:
            aggregationStrategy: "#avgMinMaxStrategy"
            correlationExpression:
              simple: "${body[sensorId]}"
            completionInterval: 60000
            steps:
              - setBody:
                  simple: "power_metrics,sensor=${body[sensorId]} avg=${body[avg]},min=${body[min]},max=${body[max]},count=${body[count]}"
              - to:
                  uri: "influxdb:influxConnection"
                  parameters:
                    databaseName: iot_aggregates
              - log:
                  message: "1-min aggregate: sensor=${body[sensorId]} avg=${body[avg]}"

flows.name: iot-device-command
flows.description: Send commands to IoT devices via MQTT with acknowledgement tracking
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: iot-device-command
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/devices/{deviceId}/command"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: deviceId
            simple: "${header.deviceId}"
        - setProperty:
            name: commandId
            simple: "${exchangeId}"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"commandId":"${exchangeProperty.commandId}","action":"${body[action]}","params":${body[params]},"timestamp":"${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}"}'
        - toD:
            uri: "paho-mqtt5:devices/${exchangeProperty.deviceId}/commands"
            parameters:
              brokerUrl: "tcp://mqtt-broker:1883"
              qos: 2
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"commandId":"${exchangeProperty.commandId}","status":"SENT","deviceId":"${exchangeProperty.deviceId}"}'
        - log:
            message: "Command sent to device ${exchangeProperty.deviceId}"

flows.name: iot-edge-gateway
flows.description: Edge gateway aggregating data from local sensors and forwarding to cloud
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: iot-edge-gateway
    from:
      uri: "paho-mqtt5:local-sensors/#"
      parameters:
        brokerUrl: "tcp://localhost:1883"
        qos: 0
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: topic
            simple: "${header.CamelMqttTopic}"
        - aggregate:
            aggregationStrategy: "#edgeBatchStrategy"
            correlationExpression:

flows.name: iot-predictive-maintenance

flows.name: orch-order-workflow
