flows.name: orch-retry-with-backoff
flows.description: Multi-step processing with exponential backoff retry on failure
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: orch-retry-with-backoff
    from:
      uri: "kafka:tasks-to-process"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: task-processor
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - onException:
            exception:
              - "org.apache.camel.http.base.HttpOperationFailedException"
            maximumRedeliveries: 5
            redeliveryDelay: 2000
            backOffMultiplier: 2
            retryAttemptedLogLevel: WARN
            handled:
              constant: "true"
            steps:
              - setBody:
                  simple: '{"taskId":"${exchangeProperty.taskId}","status":"FAILED_AFTER_RETRIES","attempts":5}'
              - to:
                  uri: "kafka:failed-tasks"
                  parameters:
                    brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        - setProperty:
            name: taskId
            simple: "${body[taskId]}"
        - to:
            uri: "http:step1-service:8080/api/process"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
              connectTimeout: 5000
        - to:
            uri: "http:step2-service:8080/api/enrich"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
              connectTimeout: 5000
        - to:
            uri: "http:step3-service:8080/api/finalize"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
              connectTimeout: 5000
        - log:
            message: "Task ${exchangeProperty.taskId} completed all steps"

flows.name: orch-timeout-compensation

flows.name: orch-approval-workflow
flows.description: Document approval workflow with human-in-the-loop via email notification
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:

    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/workflows/approval/submit"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: requestId
            simple: "${exchangeId}"
        - to:
            uri: "sql:INSERT INTO approval_requests (id, requester, data, status, created_at) VALUES (:#${exchangeProperty.requestId}, :#${body[requester]}, :#${body[data]}, 'PENDING', NOW())"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#workflowDataSource"
        - setHeader:
            name: To
            simple: "${body[approverEmail]}"
        - setHeader:
            name: Subject
            simple: "Approval Required: ${body[title]}"
        - setBody:
            simple: "Please review and approve request ${exchangeProperty.requestId}"
        - to:
            uri: "smtp:mail-server:587"
        - setBody:
            simple: '{"requestId":"${exchangeProperty.requestId}","status":"PENDING_APPROVAL"}'
- route:
    id: orch-approval-decision
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/workflows/approval/{requestId}/decide"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: decision
            simple: "${body[decision]}"
        - to:
            uri: "sql:UPDATE approval_requests SET status = :#${exchangeProperty.decision} WHERE id = :#${header.requestId}"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#workflowDataSource"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.decision} == 'APPROVED'"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:orch-execute-approved-action"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - to:
                    uri: "direct:orch-notify-rejection"

flows.name: orch-batch-processor
flows.description: Scheduled batch processing with progress tracking and error collection
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: orch-batch-processor
    from:
      uri: "quartz:batch-job?cron=0+0+2+*+*+?"
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: batchId
            simple: "${exchangeId}"
        - to:
            uri: "sql:INSERT INTO batch_runs (id, status, started_at) VALUES (:#${exchangeProperty.batchId}, 'RUNNING', NOW())"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#batchDataSource"
        - to:
            uri: "sql:SELECT * FROM pending_items WHERE processed = false LIMIT 1000"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#batchDataSource"
              outputType: SelectList
        - setProperty:
            name: totalItems
            simple: "${body.size()}"
        - setProperty:
            name: errorCount
            constant: "0"
        - split:
            expression:
              simple: "${body}"
            steps:
              - doTry:
                  steps:
                    - to:
                        uri: "http:processing-service:8080/api/process"
                        parameters:
                          httpMethod: POST
                    - to:
                        uri: "sql:UPDATE pending_items SET processed = true WHERE id = :#${body[id]}"
                        parameters:
                          dataSource: "#batchDataSource"
                  doCatch:
                    - exception:
                        - "java.lang.Exception"
                      steps:
                        - log:
                            message: "Batch item failed: ${body[id]}"
        - to:
            uri: "sql:UPDATE batch_runs SET status = 'COMPLETED', total = :#${exchangeProperty.totalItems}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = :#${exchangeProperty.batchId}"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#batchDataSource"
        - log:
            message: "Batch ${exchangeProperty.batchId} completed: ${exchangeProperty.totalItems} items"

flows.name: orch-conditional-branching
flows.description: Orchestration with conditional branching based on intermediate results
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: orch-conditional-branching
    from:
      uri: "kafka:loan-applications"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: loan-processor
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: applicationId
            simple: "${body[applicationId]}"
        - to:
            uri: "http:credit-service:8080/api/check"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: creditScore
            simple: "${body[score]}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.creditScore} > 750"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:orch-auto-approve"
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.creditScore} > 600"
                steps:
                  - to:
                      uri: "direct:orch-manual-review"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - to:
                    uri: "direct:orch-auto-reject"
- route:
    id: orch-auto-approve
    from:
      uri: "direct:orch-auto-approve"
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "http:loan-service:8080/api/approve"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - to:
            uri: "http:disbursement-service:8080/api/disburse"
            parameters:
              httpMethod: POST
        - log:
            message: "Loan auto-approved: ${exchangeProperty.applicationId}"

flows.name: orch-event-driven-workflow
flows.description: Event-driven workflow with state machine transitions
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: orch-event-driven-workflow
    from:
      uri: "kafka:workflow-events"
      parameters:
        brokers: "kafka-broker:9092"
        groupId: workflow-engine
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: workflowId
            simple: "${body[workflowId]}"
        - setProperty:
            name: event
            simple: "${body[event]}"
        - toD:
            uri: "sql:SELECT current_state FROM workflows WHERE id = :#${exchangeProperty.workflowId}"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#workflowDataSource"
              outputType: SelectOne
        - setProperty:
            name: currentState
            simple: "${body[current_state]}"
        - bean:
            ref: "#stateMachineEngine"
            method: "transition(${exchangeProperty.currentState}, ${exchangeProperty.event})"
        - setProperty:
            name: nextState
            simple: "${body}"
        - to:
            uri: "sql:UPDATE workflows SET current_state = :#${exchangeProperty.nextState}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = :#${exchangeProperty.workflowId}"
            parameters:
              dataSource: "#workflowDataSource"
        - toD:
            uri: "direct:state-${exchangeProperty.nextState}"
        - log:
            message: "Workflow ${exchangeProperty.workflowId}: ${exchangeProperty.currentState} -> ${exchangeProperty.nextState}"

flows.name: orch-pipeline-pattern

        - setHeader:
            name: pipeline-stage
            constant: "sanitized"
- route:
    id: stage-transform
    from:
      uri: "direct:stage-transform"
      steps:
        - bean:

        - setHeader:
            name: pipeline-stage
            constant: "transformed"

    id: stage-enrich

flows.name: orch-async-with-callback

flows.name: hybrid-aws-azure-failover
flows.description: Multi-cloud storage with automatic failover from AWS to Azure
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-aws-azure-failover
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/storage/upload"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: fileName
            simple: "${header.CamelFileName}"
        - setProperty:
            name: fileContent
            simple: "${body}"
        - doTry:
            steps:
              - setHeader:
                  name: CamelAwsS3Key
                  simple: "uploads/${exchangeProperty.fileName}"
              - to:
                  uri: "aws2-s3:primary-bucket"
                  parameters:
                    region: us-east-1
              - setBody:
                  simple: '{"provider":"AWS","location":"s3://primary-bucket/uploads/${exchangeProperty.fileName}"}'

                  message: "Stored in AWS S3 (primary)"
            doCatch:
              - exception:
                  - "software.amazon.awssdk.core.exception.SdkException"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "AWS S3 unavailable - failing over to Azure"
                      loggingLevel: WARN
                  - setBody:
                      simple: "${exchangeProperty.fileContent}"
                  - setHeader:
                      name: CamelAzureStorageBlobBlobName
                      simple: "uploads/${exchangeProperty.fileName}"
                  - to:
                      uri: "azure-storage-blob:failoverstorageaccount/backup-container"
                  - setBody:
                      simple: '{"provider":"Azure","location":"azure://backup-container/uploads/${exchangeProperty.fileName}"}'
                  - log:
                      message: "Stored in Azure Blob (failover)"

flows.name: hybrid-multi-cloud-sync

flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-multi-cloud-sync
    from:
      uri: "timer:cloud-sync"

        period: 300000
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "aws2-s3:source-bucket"
            parameters:
              region: us-east-1
              operation: listObjects
              prefix: "critical/"
        - split:
            expression:
              simple: "${body}"
            steps:
              - setProperty:
                  name: objectKey
                  simple: "${body.key()}"
              - toD:
                  uri: "aws2-s3:source-bucket?region=us-east-1&operation=getObject&key=${exchangeProperty.objectKey}"
              - multicast:
                  parallelProcessing: true
                  stopOnException: false
                  steps:
                    - to:
                        uri: "azure-storage-blob:syncstorageaccount/sync-container"
                    - to:
                        uri: "google-storage:sync-bucket"
        - log:
            message: "Multi-cloud sync cycle completed"

flows.name: hybrid-cloud-cost-router
flows.description: Route storage to cheapest cloud based on real-time pricing
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-cloud-cost-router
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/storage/smart-upload"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: fileSize
            simple: "${header.Content-Length}"
        - setProperty:
            name: storageClass
            simple: "${header.X-Storage-Class}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.storageClass} == 'ARCHIVE' && ${exchangeProperty.fileSize} > 1073741824"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Large archive -> GCP (cheapest for cold storage)"
                  - to:
                      uri: "google-storage:archive-bucket"
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.storageClass} == 'FREQUENT_ACCESS'"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Frequent access -> AWS S3 Standard"
                  - to:
                      uri: "aws2-s3:hot-storage-bucket"
                      parameters:
                        region: us-east-1
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.fileSize} < 1048576"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Small file -> Azure (best small object pricing)"
                  - to:
                      uri: "azure-storage-blob:costefficient/small-objects"
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - to:
                    uri: "aws2-s3:default-bucket"
                    parameters:
                      region: us-east-1
        - log:
            message: "Smart upload routed based on cost optimization"

flows.name: hybrid-edge-cloud-sync

flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:

      steps:
        - setProperty:

            simple: "${header.CamelFileName}"
        - doTry:
            steps:
              - setHeader:
                  name: CamelAwsS3Key
                  simple: "edge-data/${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd}/${exchangeProperty.fileName}"
              - to:
                  uri: "aws2-s3:edge-sync-bucket"
                  parameters:
                    region: us-east-1
              - setBody:
                  simple: '{"file":"${exchangeProperty.fileName}","synced":true,"timestamp":"${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}"}'
              - to:
                  uri: "kafka:edge-sync-events"
                  parameters:
                    brokers: "cloud-kafka:9092"
              - log:
                  message: "Edge file synced to cloud: ${exchangeProperty.fileName}"
            doCatch:
              - exception:
                  - "java.lang.Exception"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Cloud sync failed (offline?) - file will retry: ${exchangeProperty.fileName}"
                      loggingLevel: WARN

flows.name: hybrid-dns-failover
flows.description: Active-passive failover between primary and DR cloud regions
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-dns-failover
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/resilient/{path}"
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: requestPath
            simple: "${header.path}"
        - setProperty:
            name: requestBody
            simple: "${body}"
        - doTry:
            steps:
              - toD:
                  uri: "http:us-east-primary.internal:8080/${exchangeProperty.requestPath}"
                  parameters:
                    connectTimeout: 3000
                    socketTimeout: 10000
              - setHeader:
                  name: X-Served-From
                  constant: "us-east-primary"
              - log:
                  message: "Served from primary region (us-east)"
            doCatch:
              - exception:
                  - "java.net.ConnectException"
                  - "java.net.SocketTimeoutException"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Primary region failed - routing to DR (eu-west)"
                      loggingLevel: WARN
                  - setBody:
                      simple: "${exchangeProperty.requestBody}"
                  - toD:
                      uri: "http:eu-west-dr.internal:8080/${exchangeProperty.requestPath}"
                      parameters:
                        connectTimeout: 5000
                        socketTimeout: 15000
                  - setHeader:
                      name: X-Served-From
                      constant: "eu-west-dr"

flows.name: hybrid-cloud-burst
flows.description: Cloud bursting: overflow to public cloud when on-prem capacity exceeded
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-cloud-burst
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/api/compute"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: POST
      steps:
        - bean:
            ref: "#capacityChecker"
            method: "getOnPremLoad"
        - setProperty:
            name: onPremLoad
            simple: "${body}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.onPremLoad} < 80"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "On-prem capacity available (${exchangeProperty.onPremLoad}%) - processing locally"
                  - to:
                      uri: "http:onprem-compute.internal:8080/api/process"
                      parameters:
                        httpMethod: POST
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "On-prem at ${exchangeProperty.onPremLoad}% - bursting to cloud"
                - to:
                    uri: "http:cloud-compute.amazonaws.com/api/process"
                    parameters:
                      httpMethod: POST
                - setHeader:
                    name: X-Execution-Location
                    constant: "cloud-burst"

flows.name: hybrid-secret-federation
flows.description: Federated secret management across multiple cloud vaults
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-secret-federation
    from:
      uri: "platform-http:/secrets/{provider}/{key}"
      parameters:
        httpMethodRestrict: GET
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: provider
            simple: "${header.provider}"
        - setProperty:
            name: secretKey
            simple: "${header.key}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.provider} == 'vault'"
                steps:
                  - toD:
                      uri: "hashicorp-vault:secret"
                      parameters:
                        secretPath: "${exchangeProperty.secretKey}"
                        vaultHost: vault.internal
                        vaultPort: 8200
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.provider} == 'aws'"
                steps:
                  - toD:
                      uri: "aws-secrets-manager:${exchangeProperty.secretKey}"
                      parameters:
                        region: us-east-1
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.provider} == 'azure'"
                steps:
                  - toD:
                      uri: "azure-key-vault:${exchangeProperty.secretKey}"
                      parameters:
                        vaultName: mykeyvault
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - setHeader:
                    name: CamelHttpResponseCode
                    constant: "400"
                - setBody:
                    constant: '{"error":"Unsupported provider"}'
        - log:
            message: "Secret retrieved from ${exchangeProperty.provider}"

flows.name: hybrid-data-residency
flows.description: Route data to appropriate cloud region based on data residency requirements
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-data-residency
    from:

        groupId: data-residency-router
      steps:
        - unmarshal:

              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: dataRegion
            simple: "${body[region]}"
        - setProperty:
            name: dataId
            simple: "${body[id]}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.dataRegion} in 'EU,DE,FR,IT'"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "EU data residency - storing in Azure EU West"
                  - setHeader:
                      name: CamelAzureStorageBlobBlobName
                      simple: "eu-data/${exchangeProperty.dataId}.json"
                  - to:
                      uri: "azure-storage-blob:eudatastorageaccount/customer-data"

                  - to:
                      uri: "aws2-s3:americas-data-bucket"

                        region: us-east-1
            otherwise:
              steps:
                - log:
                    message: "APAC/other - storing in default region"
                - setHeader:
                    name: CamelAwsS3Key
                    simple: "global-data/${exchangeProperty.dataId}.json"
                - to:
                    uri: "aws2-s3:global-data-bucket"
                    parameters:
                      region: ap-southeast-1

flows.name: hybrid-multi-cloud-queue

- route:

flows.name: hybrid-cloud-migration
flows.description: Live data migration from AWS to Azure with progress tracking
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: hybrid-cloud-migration
    from:
      uri: "timer:migration-batch"
      parameters:
        period: 60000
      steps:
        - to:
            uri: "aws2-s3:source-bucket"
            parameters:
              region: us-east-1
              operation: listObjects
              prefix: "to-migrate/"
              maxKeys: 100
        - split:
            expression:
              simple: "${body}"
            streaming: true
            steps:
              - setProperty:
                  name: objectKey
                  simple: "${body.key()}"
              - toD:
                  uri: "aws2-s3:source-bucket?region=us-east-1&operation=getObject&key=${exchangeProperty.objectKey}"
              - setHeader:
                  name: CamelAzureStorageBlobBlobName
                  simple: "migrated/${exchangeProperty.objectKey}"
              - to:
                  uri: "azure-storage-blob:migrationstorageaccount/target-container"
              - toD:
                  uri: "aws2-s3:source-bucket?region=us-east-1&operation=deleteObject&key=${exchangeProperty.objectKey}"
              - log:
                  message: "Migrated: ${exchangeProperty.objectKey}"
        - log:
            message: "Migration batch completed"

flows.name: hybrid-rosa-sqs-order-processor

flows.name: hybrid-rosa-s3-document-api
flows.description: REST API on ROSA that stores and retrieves documents in Amazon S3 using IRSA workload identity

            name: docId
            simple: "${header.X-Document-Id}"
        - choice:
            when:
              - simple: "${exchangeProperty.action} == 'upload'"
                steps:
                  - setHeader:
                      name: CamelAwsS3Key
                      simple: "documents/${exchangeProperty.docId}.json"
                  - to:

flows.name: hybrid-rosa-sns-alert-fanout

                    parameters:
                      region: us-east-1
        - log:
            message: "Alert ${exchangeProperty.severity} published to SNS from ROSA"

flows.name: hybrid-aro-servicebus-orders

flows.name: hybrid-gcp-pubsub-events

flows.name: hybrid-gcp-storage-archive

    id: github-repos-paginated
    from:

      parameters:
        period: "600000"
        repeatCount: 1
      steps:
        - setProperty:
            name: currentPage
            constant: "1"
        - setProperty:
            name: orgName
            constant: "apache"
        - loopDoWhile:
            expression:
              simple: "${exchangeProperty.hasMore} != 'false'"
            steps:
              - setHeader:
                  name: CamelHttpMethod
                  constant: GET
              - setHeader:
                  name: User-Agent
                  constant: "CamelIntegration/1.0"
              - doTry:
                  steps:
                    - toD:
                        uri: "https://api.github.com/orgs/${exchangeProperty.orgName}/repos?page=${exchangeProperty.currentPage}&per_page=30"
                    - unmarshal:
                        json:
                          library: jackson
                    - choice:
                        when:
                          - jsonpath: "$[0]"
                            steps:
                              - split:
                                  expression:
                                    jsonpath: "$[*]"
                                  steps:
                                    - setBody:
                                        jsonpath: "$.full_name"
                                    - log:
                                        message: "Repo: ${body}"
                              - setProperty:
                                  name: currentPage

                        otherwise:
                          steps:
                            - setProperty:

                                constant: "false"
                            - log:

                    - exception:
                        - "java.lang.Exception"

                        - log:
                            message: "Pagination error: ${exception.message}"

- route:
    id: multi-channel-notify
    from:
      uri: "kafka:notification-events"
      parameters:
        brokers: "my-cluster-kafka-bootstrap:9092"
        groupId: "multi-channel-notifier"
        autoOffsetReset: latest
      steps:
        - unmarshal:
            json:
              library: jackson
        - setProperty:
            name: notifType
            jsonpath: "$.type"
        - setProperty:
            name: message
            jsonpath: "$.message"
        - setProperty:
            name: recipient
            jsonpath: "$.recipient"
        - setProperty:
            name: channels
            jsonpath: "$.channels"
        - setProperty:
            name: urgency
            jsonpath: "$.urgency"
        - log:
            message: "Dispatching ${exchangeProperty.urgency} notification to: ${exchangeProperty.channels}"
        - multicast:
            parallelProcessing: true
            stopOnException: false
            steps:
              - pipeline:
                  steps:
                    - choice:
                        when:
                          - simple: "${exchangeProperty.channels} contains 'slack'"
                            steps:
                              - doTry:
                                  steps:
                                    - setBody:
                                        simple: "[${exchangeProperty.urgency}] ${exchangeProperty.message}"
                                    - to:
                                        uri: "slack:#notifications"
                                        parameters:
                                          webhookUrl: "https://hooks.slack.com/services/YOUR/SLACK/WEBHOOK"
                                    - log:
                                        message: "Slack notification sent"
                                  doCatch:
                                    - exception:
                                        - "java.lang.Exception"
                                      steps:
                                        - log:
                                            message: "Slack delivery failed: ${exception.message}"
                                            loggingLevel: WARN
              - pipeline:
                  steps:
                    - choice:
                        when:
                          - simple: "${exchangeProperty.channels} contains 'email'"
                            steps:
                              - doTry:
                                  steps:
                                    - setBody:
                                        simple: "${exchangeProperty.message}"
                                    - setHeader:
                                        name: Subject
                                        simple: "[${exchangeProperty.urgency}] Notification"
                                    - setHeader:
                                        name: To
                                        simple: "${exchangeProperty.recipient}"
                                    - to:
                                        uri: "smtp:mail.example.com"
                                        parameters:
                                          username: "notifications@example.com"
                                          password: "{{smtp.password}}"
                                    - log:
                                        message: "Email notification sent to ${exchangeProperty.recipient}"
                                  doCatch:
                                    - exception:
                                        - "java.lang.Exception"
                                      steps:
                                        - log:
                                            message: "Email delivery failed: ${exception.message}"
                                            loggingLevel: WARN
              - pipeline:
                  steps:
                    - choice:
                        when:
                          - simple: "${exchangeProperty.channels} contains 'sms'"
                            steps:
                              - doTry:
                                  steps:
                                    - setBody:
                                        simple: '{"to":"${exchangeProperty.recipient}","body":"[${exchangeProperty.urgency}] ${exchangeProperty.message}"}'
                                    - setHeader:
                                        name: CamelHttpMethod
                                        constant: POST
                                    - setHeader:
                                        name: Content-Type
                                        constant: "application/json"
                                    - to:
                                        uri: "http://sms-gateway.internal:8080/api/v1/send"
                                    - log:
                                        message: "SMS notification sent"

                                        - log:

flows.name: data-sync-poller
flows.description: Poll source system, compare with target, upsert changes, log all modifications
flows.kaotoDesign:
- route:
    id: data-sync-poller
    from:
      uri: "timer:dataSync"
      parameters:
        period: "300000"
      steps:
        - log:
            message: "Starting data sync cycle"
        - doTry:
            steps:
              - setHeader:
                  name: CamelHttpMethod
                  constant: GET
              - to:
                  uri: "http://source-system.internal:8080/api/v1/records?modified_since=last_sync"
              - unmarshal:
                  json:
                    library: jackson
              - setProperty:
                  name: sourceRecords
                  simple: "${body}"
              - setProperty:
                  name: recordCount
                  simple: "${body.size()}"
              - choice:
                  when:
                    - simple: "${exchangeProperty.recordCount} > 0"
                      steps:
                        - split:
                            expression:
                              simple: "${exchangeProperty.sourceRecords}"
                            steps:
                              - setProperty:
                                  name: recordId
                                  jsonpath: "$.id"
                              - marshal:
                                  json:
                                    library: jackson
                              - setHeader:
                                  name: CamelHttpMethod
                                  constant: PUT
                              - setHeader:
                                  name: Content-Type
                                  constant: "application/json"
                              - doTry:
                                  steps:
                                    - toD:
                                        uri: "http://target-system.internal:8080/api/v1/records/${exchangeProperty.recordId}"
                                    - log:
                                        message: "Synced record ${exchangeProperty.recordId}"
                                    - setBody:
                                        simple: '{"action":"upsert","record_id":"${exchangeProperty.recordId}","synced_at":"${date:now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}"}'
                                    - to:
                                        uri: "kafka:sync-audit-log"
                                        parameters:
                                          brokers: "my-cluster-kafka-bootstrap:9092"
                                  doCatch:
                                    - exception:
                                        - "java.lang.Exception"
                                      steps:
                                        - log:
                                            message: "Sync failed for record ${exchangeProperty.recordId}: ${exception.message}"
                                            loggingLevel: ERROR
                        - log:
                            message: "Data sync complete: ${exchangeProperty.recordCount} records processed"
                  otherwise:
                    steps:
                      - log:
                          message: "No new records to sync"
            doCatch:
              - exception:
                  - "java.lang.Exception"
                steps:
                  - log:
                      message: "Data sync cycle failed: ${exception.message}"
                      loggingLevel: ERROR
